title: Inbox Navigation, Composing & Attachments
description: Learn Outlook mail folder navigation, drafting emails, rich text formatting, and attaching cloud files.
objectives: Navigate Mail, Calendar, Contacts, and Tasks panes
Compose, Reply, Forward, and format email messages
Attach local files and OneDrive cloud share links

steps.title: Outlook Mail Workspace
steps.content: Outlook organizes communication across Mail (Inbox, Sent, Drafts), Calendar, People (Contacts), and Tasks.

quiz.question: What is the difference between 'Reply' and 'Reply All' when responding to an email?
options: Reply sends a response only to the original sender; Reply All responds to the sender and all CC'd recipients
Reply sends email to everyone in the company
Reply All saves the email as a draft
quiz.explanation: Reply sends your message only to the sender, whereas Reply All includes all copied recipients.

title: Calendar Scheduling & Meeting Invites
description: Schedule appointments, send team meeting invitations, set reminders, and check attendee availability.
objectives: Create calendar appointments and recurring events
Send meeting invitations with Teams video links
Use Scheduling Assistant to find free time slots

steps.title: Scheduling & Time Management
steps.content: Outlook Calendar helps schedule individual work blocks, client meetings, and recurring team syncs with automatic reminder popups.

quiz.question: Which tool in Outlook Calendar displays attendees' free/busy schedules side-by-side to avoid meeting conflicts?
quiz.explanation: Scheduling Assistant visualizes team calendar availability to pick conflict-free meeting times.

title: Contacts, Distribution Lists & Address Book
description: Organize personal and business contacts, build group distribution lists, and manage contact cards.
objectives: Save new contacts with email, phone, and company info
Create Contact Groups (Distribution Lists) for team messaging

steps.title: Contact Management & Groups
steps.content: Contact Groups allow you to send an email or meeting invite to an entire department by typing a single group name.

quiz.question: What is the primary benefit of creating a Contact Group (Distribution List) in Outlook?
options: It allows you to email multiple people at once by entering a single group name
It translates emails to foreign languages
quiz.explanation: Contact Groups store list subsets of contacts for instant team messaging.

title: Email Signatures & Auto-Responders (Out of Office)
description: Design professional HTML email signatures and configure Out of Office automatic vacation replies.
objectives: Create professional signatures with company logos and social links
Set separate internal vs. external vacation messages

steps.title: Professional Email Branding
steps.content: Signatures add your job title, phone number, and logo to every outgoing email automatically, establishing corporate identity.

quiz.question: Where do you configure automated Out of Office email responses while on vacation?
options: File Tab -> Automatic Replies (Out of Office)
quiz.explanation: Automatic Replies under the File tab sends automated response messages during set absence dates.

title: Inbox Rules, Folders & Quick Steps Pro
description: Automate email sorting into folders using Rules Wizard and build one-click multi-action Quick Steps.
objectives: Create automatic inbox sorting Rules based on sender/subject
Build custom one-click Quick Steps (e.g., Move + Mark Read + Forward)
Use Focused Inbox to separate priority emails

steps.title: Inbox Zero & Workflow Automation
steps.content: Rules automatically route incoming newsletters, client tickets, or notifications into specific folders, keeping your primary inbox clean.

quiz.question: What is the function of 'Quick Steps' in Outlook?
options: It executes multiple automated actions (like moving an email and flagging it) with a single click
It counts your daily walking steps
quiz.explanation: Quick Steps combine multi-step repetitive actions into a single toolbar macro button.

title: Task Management, Flagging & Follow-ups Pro
description: Convert emails into actionable To-Do tasks, set due dates, flag priority emails, and manage productivity.
objectives: Flag emails for follow-up with due date reminders
Drag emails onto the Task icon to create action items
Assign tasks to team members and track completion

steps.title: To-Do List Integration
steps.content: Flagging an email adds it directly to your Microsoft To-Do task sidebar, ensuring important client requests are never forgotten.

quiz.question: How can you convert an email into a scheduled Task item in Outlook instantly?
options: Drag and drop the email onto the Tasks icon in the navigation bar
quiz.explanation: Dragging an email to the Tasks icon creates a Task pre-populated with the email subject and body.
